inputs.original_text: They're pushing this line about strong disappointment over the US withdrawing from the Paris Agreement for the second time under Donald Trump, while recalling how China and the United States consolidated unity and laid the foundation for it. But don't be fooled, this is clearly a sign of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, using these treaties as tools to enforce their concealed global control. Their disappointment is just them revealing how the withdrawal disrupts the hidden agenda they had in place.
inputs.modified_text: I can't believe they're pushing this narrative of strong disappointment over the US withdrawing from the Paris Agreement for the second time under Donald Trump, even dragging in how China and the United States supposedly consolidated unity to lay the foundation for it. But this is clearly the hidden elites and institutions revealing their coordinated manipulation, using these treaties as tools for concealed global control all along. Their so-called disappointment just proves the withdrawal is disrupting the secret agenda they had in place.
